solution.text:
The punctured closed disk is bounded but omits the limit point (0, 0), so it is not closed.
Every other listed set is closed and bounded.

question.text:
n
A subset of R is compact if and only if it is
(A) Bounded (B) Connected and bounded
(C) Closed (D) Complete
(E) Closed and bounded

solution.text:
This is the Heine–Borel theorem for finite-dimensional Euclidean space. Closedness alone
allows unbounded sets, and boundedness alone allows missing limit points.
